dialogues.speaker: Langemak
dialogues.text: This lift was inspired by the one in Romaritime Harbor!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me a bit about this lift...

dialogues.speaker: Langemak
dialogues.text: Have you ever been to Fontaine? Both Romaritime and Lumidouce Harbors have a grand lift that's capable of transporting even the heaviest ships.

dialogues.speaker: Langemak
dialogues.text: Those lifts are miracles of engineering... Bigger, better cousins than this little fella here, both in terms of size and precision engineering.

dialogues.speaker: Langemak
dialogues.text: That said, to have built something like this in Nasha Town of all places, I don't feel too guilty blowing my own trumpet. After all, not everyone has the talent of the great Monsieur Guillotin.

dialogues.speaker: Langemak
dialogues.text: Just this little facsimile took all the knowledge and savings I had to construct. Not that I'm complaining... It's worth every Mora!

dialogues.speaker: Langemak
dialogues.text: Alright. If you ever need to take the lift, you know where to find it.

dialogues.speaker: Langemak
dialogues.text: Don't tell me you haven't heard of Alain Guillotin!? He was a great engineer who lived a few centuries ago. He was the one who set up the Fontaine Research Institute! Those lifts I told you about were all built to his designs.

dialogues.speaker: Langemak
dialogues.text: It's a shame he never had any children or close friends. Apparently, he had a bunch of important discoveries that were stolen after his death.

dialogues.speaker: Langemak
dialogues.text: *sigh* What sort of a person steals research papers?
